product_one_liner.value: Multiplier acquires boutique professional-services firms and builds custom AI workflow tools that help their tax, accounting and advisory professionals automate manual work and serve more clients.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plans were found; the /pricing URL returned no readable page, and the company builds tools for its own portfolio rather than selling standalone software.

named_customers.notes: The homepage testimonials and portfolio identify owned firms and partners, not independent customers; no qualifying customer roster, customer case-study page or review listing for this company was found.

employee_band.notes: Company profiles report 38 and 33 employees, respectively; both fall within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The Ideas index contains leadership, company philosophy and career commentary, not at least two engineer-authored articles explaining product architecture or implementation; employee LinkedIn product showcases do not establish an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation or help-center link was found, and the docs and help subdomains returned no readable pages; the product terms are not a documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the six currently listed job titles is an eligible AI, ML or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed technology, legal/privacy, blog and available documentation locations and searched for a public subprocessor list; no product model provider was disclosed. References to Claude Code or Codex as development tools do not establish the product’s model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Neither legal page claims SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR certification or PCI DSS certification. The privacy policy references UK GDPR transfer safeguards, not a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The $35 million Series B was announced on 2026-08-04, within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The board lists Sales & Business Development Associate (Rooled.com), not SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive; this adjacent title is excluded under the requested title rule.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest explicit launch announcement found is the 2025-06-18 public launch, outside the window. Later hiring/product-showcase posts describe previously built tools without announcing a dated new release; they were not treated as launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Allen Shim joined as President and CFO, announced on 2026-08-04.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The portfolio-company sales posting explicitly says “Maintain our CRM (HubSpot).” Streak and Apollo appear only as examples of prior familiarity, not confirmed systems in use.
